notes.title: Update #3 - Difficulty Levels
notes.notes: [h3]Welcome Survivors![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Game Update #3[/b][/h3][p]- Added Difficulty Settings when starting a new game, not dropping items on death is also an option[/p][p]- New late game weapon: Spectral Shotgun[/p][p]- Crafting Tab Reworked: when interacting with a crafting station, only the station's recipes will be displayed[/p][p]- Interaction HUD will properly display the name of crafting stations[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/3a7aaf646f1a32b8d36b3ebf7db5f37e95a88e02.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]The Dev's recommendation:[/h3][list][*][p][b]World: Easy & Character: Softcore[/b] is best suited for those who want to focus more on exploring the world and worry less about the danger level of enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]World: Normal & Character: Normal[/b] is the standard experience where enemies are a real danger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]World: Expert[/b] is just brutal. Most enemies will kill you with two shots, maybe more if you equip the right gear. Combined with [b]Character Difficulty: Softcore[/b] it will make the experience a bit smoother since you can get right back to action not having to worry about retrieving lost items. But combined with [b]Character Difficulty: Normal[/b] the player will be heavily punished for every single mistake.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/5pf2r6kScD" style="button"]Discord Server[/url] and tell me about your experience and potential feedback! Have fun![/p]

notes.title: Game Update #1
notes.notes:
Welcome, Survivors!

I've been working in real time, fixing bugs, making changes and working on new content. 
Here are a couple of them:
- fixed Mausoleum enemies not dropping rare loot
- background music no longer causes a short freeze on load
- added a new sound for player death
- crafting with equipped accessories and armor will track stats properly
- controls info added in Option Panel
- added small polish elements for destroying resources

Expect a [b]new content update[/b] very soon. An update that will unfold and complete the story of the city.
Huge thanks to the players, your support means a lot to me!

Feedback is very valuable, please share it with me: [url=https://discord.gg/5pf2r6kScD]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Date Release Announcement & Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Wait is Almost Over – Desolated District Release Date Revealed![/h1]

We're thrilled to finally announce the official release date for [b]Desolated District[/b]! Mark your calendars: [b]May 22nd[/b] is the day the full experience goes live.

To celebrate this milestone, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer showcasing new content, updated visuals, and a glimpse at what awaits you in the full game.

[previewyoutube=LM9U1wMx4nQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Final Demo Content Update – Available Now![/h2]

Alongside the release date announcement, we’re also rolling out one last content update for the demo. This update introduces new features, balance tweaks, and fresh content to give players a final taste of what's to come
[list]
[*]Quest System
[*]Biome System
[*]Added the Slime Boss
[*]New Zone: The Slug Nest
[*]New Creature: the Hoarder Slug
[*]Total UI Refactor
[*]Metal Tower Parkour reworked
[*]Slime Enemy Balance
[*]New Main Menu Scene
[*]Rooftops small visual changes
[/list]
Your support has meant the world to us. We can’t wait to share the full version with you and see what you build, explore, and survive in [b]Desolated District[/b].

[h3][b]Wishlist[/b] now and stay tuned for more updates as we approach launch day![/h3]

notes.title: Final Demo Update Incoming
notes.notes:
[h1]Big things are coming to Desolated District![/h1]

We’re excited to announce that the final demo update will be launching on April 27th on Steam!

[h3]This update is packed with content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New enemies lurking in unexplored corners
[*] A new boss ready to test your skills
[*] New systems to deepen your survival experience
[*] A fully reworked UI interface
[*] And plenty of overall polish to bring the game world to life
[/list]
We’ll reveal all the gritty details on launch day so stay tuned.

In the meantime, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/5pf2r6kScD]Discord[/url] for sneak peeks, dev updates, and to chat with fellow survivors.

Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/66db67d356f401094bdec71f2c04ed1cd36c91e0.png[/img]

See you out there, survivor. Stay sharp.

[h2]Items, Storage & Crafting System[/h2]
Discover new items to craft and explore intricate crafting recipes that will challenge your survival skills.
